en.summary: The commit fixes LSU duplicate-address detection by comparing full byte addresses instead of a word-aligned address that had already discarded low-order offset bits.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly describes an addressing fix
The patch is confined to core LSU RTL and changes request classification behavior
The main semantic change preserves address precision until after duplicate detection
disqualifiers: The region-classification rewrites in the same hunk appear secondary to the primary duplicate-detection fix
evidence: The old code derived word_addr = full_addr[REQ_ASHIFT +: REQ_ADDRW] before duplicate detection
The fix removes word_addr from duplicate comparison and instead compares full_addr[0] with full_addr[i]
The commit message is specifically 'duplicate addressing fix', which aligns with the duplicate-detection edit more directly than with the range-check cleanup

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When an LSU or coalescer tries to determine whether multiple lane accesses target the same location, it must compare addresses at the precision required by the memory operation. If the logic drops byte-offset bits too early and compares only word-aligned addresses, accesses to different bytes within the same word can be falsely treated as duplicates, leading to incorrect coalescing, masking, or routing.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Multiple active lanes issue memory accesses that share the same word address but differ in lower byte-offset bits
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Perform duplicate detection on a shifted or word-aligned address representation instead of the full byte address
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: truncate low-order address bits before duplicate comparison
portability_notes: Apply this to lane coalescers, duplicate suppressors, or merged LSU request builders
The relevant address precision is the smallest unit at which the DUT distinguishes independent accesses
If the DUT supports subword operations, do not preserve byte offsets in the injected bug
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the logic that decides whether per-lane memory accesses are duplicates or can be merged
Identify the full effective address before any word alignment or block alignment is applied
Replace the comparison input with a version that drops the low offset bits used to distinguish subword accesses
Keep the rest of the merge or duplicate-suppression logic unchanged so the injected bug is specifically loss of address precision

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: LSU duplicate-address detection around full_addr and removed word_addr
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix deletes word_addr-based duplicate matching and compares full_addr directly; the same patch also rewrites range checks to use full_addr slices.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the removed word_addr array and compare addr_matches using word_addr rather than full_addr.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Distinct subword accesses can be merged or suppressed as if they targeted the same location, producing incorrect LSU coalescing and potentially wrong load or store behavior.
evidence_for_injection: The removed word_addr path explicitly drops REQ_ASHIFT low-order bits before comparison
The fixed code now compares full_addr for addr_matches, which preserves those low bits
The commit title singles out duplicate addressing, matching the duplicate-comparison change exactly
notes: For cross-DUT reuse, focus on the duplicate-comparison precision bug; the range-check edits can be treated as source-level cleanup around the same address source
This bug is especially easy to trigger with byte or halfword operations issued by multiple lanes

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 LSU 的重复地址检测错误：比较时改用完整字节地址，而不是已经丢掉低位偏移信息的按字对齐地址。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明修复的是 addressing 问题
补丁只改动了核心 LSU RTL，并直接影响请求分类行为
核心语义变化是在重复地址检测之前保留完整地址精度
disqualifiers: 同一个补丁里对地址范围判定的改写更像是围绕主修复的配套整理，而不是主要缺陷本体
evidence: 旧代码先构造 word_addr = full_addr[REQ_ASHIFT +: REQ_ADDRW]，再用于重复地址检测
修复删除了基于 word_addr 的重复比较，改为直接比较 full_addr[0] 与 full_addr[i]
提交标题就是 'duplicate addressing fix'，与重复检测修改的对应关系比地址范围判定更直接

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当 LSU 或 lane coalescer 需要判断多个 lane 的访问是否指向同一位置时，比较地址必须保留该内存操作所需的最小精度。如果逻辑过早丢弃了字节偏移位，只比较按字对齐后的地址，那么对同一个 word 中不同字节的访问就可能被错误地视为重复访问，进而引发错误合并、错误掩码或错误路由。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 多个活跃 lane 发出的内存访问拥有相同 word 地址，但低位字节偏移不同
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在重复检测时使用移位后的按字对齐地址，而不是完整字节地址
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 在重复比较前截断低位地址偏移
portability_notes: 可映射到 lane coalescer、duplicate suppressor 或合并式 LSU 请求构造逻辑
应保留的地址精度取决于 DUT 判断“两个访问是否独立”的最小粒度
如果 DUT 支持 subword 操作，注入时就不要保留这些字节偏移位
concrete_injection_steps: 找到负责判断各 lane 内存访问是否重复或可合并的逻辑
定位在做 word 对齐或 block 对齐之前的完整有效地址
把比较输入替换成去掉低位偏移后的地址表示
保持其余合并或重复抑制逻辑不变，使注入错误明确体现为“地址精度丢失”

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 围绕 full_addr 与已删除 word_addr 的 LSU 重复地址检测逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复删除了基于 word_addr 的重复匹配，改为直接比较 full_addr；同一补丁也把范围判定切换到 full_addr 切片。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复已删除的 word_addr 数组，并让 addr_matches 改回比较 word_addr 而不是 full_addr。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 原本指向不同子字节位置的访问会被误判为同一地址，从而被错误合并或抑制，导致 LSU 合并行为错误，进而影响 load/store 结果。
evidence_for_injection: 被删除的 word_addr 路径在比较前明确丢弃了 REQ_ASHIFT 个低位地址位
修复后的 addr_matches 使用 full_addr，说明这些低位现在被保留下来
提交标题明确指向 duplicate addressing，与重复比较这一改动完全一致
notes: 为了跨 DUT 复用，应把重点放在“重复比较精度不足”这个错误上；范围判定的改写可视为围绕同一地址源的配套整理
这个错误尤其容易在多 lane 的 byte 或 halfword 操作中触发
